SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) r, sum(net_sales) n, count(*) ndays
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.business_date
WHERE x.store_id=900 AND x.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) dist, sum(f.net_amount) gross_of_returns, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.net_amount) fa, count(distinct receipt_id) rc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, net_sales_before_returns ra, receipts rr FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900)
SELECT f.d, fa, ra, round(ra-fa,2) diff, rc, rr FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.d=r.d WHERE f.d BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND abs(coalesce(ra,0)-coalesce(fa,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_utc_date, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc + INTERVAL 3 HOUR AS DATE)<>sale_date AND CAST(sale_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_local
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key=46 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY 2
